name: harness-apis-catalog
goal: Selected-revision APIs catalog lists project endpoints, and page APIs tabs show source-proven direct and transitive usage with correct contracts and scoped links

evidence: Selected project and revision APIs, source-derived direct/transitive page usage, contracts, consumer links, responsive and historical empty states are specified and covered.
Shared catalog/category, page tab, HTTP source resolution and registry-backed CLI API reads implemented; live CLI reads 14 endpoints without restarting the shared server.

112 root/source/ownership/import cases, 23 local/hosted CLI cases, 3 viewport flows and 9 API route preview cases pass in their recorded scopes. Full repository verification remains pending baseline failures.
